reason: The plugin integrates OpenAI Codex as a DSH model provider, with device-code OAuth, Codex CLI session import, token refresh, credential management, and a settings interface.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenAI Codex，提供设备码 OAuth 登录、Codex CLI 登录态导入、令牌刷新和供应商设置管理。
summaries.en: Connects OpenAI Codex to DeepSeek Harness with device-code OAuth login, Codex CLI session import, token refresh, and provider settings management.

capabilities: Importing Codex CLI authentication state from a local file
Storing and automatically refreshing access and refresh tokens
Sending authenticated requests to OpenAI authentication and Codex service endpoints
Providing a supplier settings interface and activating Codex models
